from langflow.custom import CustomComponent
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Data
import re

class TTSFormatter(CustomComponent):
    display_name = "TTS Output Formatter"
    description = "Formats output for text-to-speech"
    
    def build_config(self):
        return {
            "llm_response": {
                "display_name": "LLM Response",
                "field_type": "str",
            }
        }
    
    def build(
        self,
        llm_response: str
    ) -> Data:
        # Clean the response for TTS
        cleaned = llm_response
        
        # Remove any markdown formatting
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'\1', cleaned)  # Bold
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\*(.+?)\*', r'\1', cleaned)  # Italic
        cleaned = re.sub(r'#+\s', '', cleaned)  # Headers
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\n\s*[-*]\s+', ', ', cleaned)  # Bullet points
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\n\s*\d+\.\s+', ', ', cleaned)  # Numbered lists
        
        # Remove emojis
        emoji_pattern = re.compile(
            "["
            u"\U0001F600-\U0001F64F"
            u"\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF"
            u"\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF"
            u"\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF"
            u"\U00002702-\U000027B0"
            u"\U000024C2-\U0001F251"
            "]+", flags=re.UNICODE
        )
        cleaned = emoji_pattern.sub('', cleaned)
        
        # Clean up whitespace
        cleaned = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', cleaned)
        cleaned = cleaned.strip()
        
        # Ensure natural speech flow
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(' , ', ', ')
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(' . ', '. ')
        
        result = {
            "tts_output": cleaned,
            "original_response": llm_response
        }
        
        return Data(data=result)
